title: Anbu — You are never alone · Averic Lab
meta_desc: A quiet word that arrives without being spoken. A daily, automatic check-in that keeps the people you love gently close. Anbu — by Averic Lab.
og_desc: A quiet word that arrives without being spoken. A daily, automatic check-in for the people you love.
tw_desc: A quiet word that arrives without being spoken. A daily, automatic check-in.
hero_sub_html:
A word that arrives without being spoken.
Somewhere today, a quiet check-in is flowing.
cta_h3_html:
Starting today,
let a check-in flow every day.
cta_lead_html:
Free for the one sharing.
A 3-month free trial, then $9.99/year for the caregiver.
coming_soon: Coming Soon · See you very soon
dawn_q1_html:
When you are hurting, or unwell —
who would be the first to come?
dawn_q2_html:
And right at this moment,
has their day been all right?
intro_title_html:
Someone you love lives alone —
checking in every day isn't easy.
intro_sub_html:
They're far away, and you wonder if they're okay today — but calling every day is hard.
When something happens, someone should know. Anbu delivers the word for you.
step1_p: No complicated setup. Only the way your check-in is sent differs slightly by phone.
step1_android: Nothing to do — your check-in is sent automatically at the chosen time.
step1_iphone: Once a day, a gentle reminder appears. Just tap it once — that's all it takes.
step2_p: A quiet signal reaches your loved ones at the same time each day, sensed naturally from movement and everyday use.
step3_p: Even without reaching them directly, you can tell how they're doing — step by step. Reach out yourself only when it truly matters.
levels_title_html: Only when needed, only as much as needed.
levels_sub: Not every alert is an emergency. Anbu shares the situation in five quiet steps.
privacy_title_html: No names. No phone numbers. Nothing personal.
privacy_sub: We protect the privacy of the people you care about. Connection happens through a single code we issue — nothing more.
privacy_b1_html: Names, phone numbers, addresses are never stored on our servers.
privacy_b2_html: Location is shared only when the [I need help] button is pressed by the user.
privacy_b3_html: Personal data like call logs and photos is never collected. Ever.
contact_sub: Partnership, collaboration, or a general question — leave a message and we'll reply as soon as we can.
form_msg_ph: Tell us what you have in mind.
file_help: If you'd like to share files, please paste a Google Drive / Dropbox link in your message.
status_success: Thank you — your message has been sent. We'll reply shortly.
status_error: We couldn't send your message. Please try again in a moment.
footer_brand_desc: A studio crafting mobile applications that bring meaningful value to everyday life.
